title: Unordered list
description: Enhances a <ul>: checklist and icon-list variants, marker style, indent and item spacing.

variant.description: List style. checklist ticks items marked `checked`; icon-list uses each item's `icon`; none hides the markers.

marker.description: CSS list-style-type for the bullets (disc, circle, square, ...). Ignored by the checklist, icon-list and none variants, which draw their own.

indentSize.description: Left indent of the list (any CSS length). Ignored by the checklist, icon-list and none variants.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
